'''Zeven''' was a [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] and one of [[Suudaa Nem'ro]]'s smugglers during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].
